name: std::this_thread::yield
intro: Provides a hint to the implementation to reschedule the execution of threads, allowing other threads to run.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The exact behavior of this function depends on the implementation, in particular on the mechanics of the OS scheduler in use and the state of the system. For example, a first-in-first-out realtime scheduler (SCHED_FIFO in Linux) would suspend the current thread and put it on the back of the queue of the same-priority threads that are ready to run, and if there are no other threads at the same priority, yield has no effect.

summary: Provides a hint to the implementation to reschedule the execution of threads, allowing other threads to run.
